title: DevFest Lucknow 2026: Where Builders Meet
description:
DevFest Lucknow 2026: Where Builders Meet

What happens when a year of learning, experimenting, and building comes together under one roof?

Welcome to DevFest Lucknow 2026, the grand finale of our year-long Builder Culture journey.

This year, we've been moving beyond simply attending events. We've been creating opportunities for developers to build real products, experiment with AI, solve meaningful problems, collaborate with others, and turn ideas into working solutions.

Now, it's time to bring that energy together.

What to Expect

Learn from the community

Explore technology, AI, cloud, software development, and product engineering through insightful talks, practical sessions, and conversations with experienced developers and industry practitioners.

Discover what people are building

Visit our Builder Arena, a dedicated product showcase featuring projects from community buildathons, hackathons, independent developers, student teams, and startups. Meet the people behind the products, experience their demos, exchange feedback, and discover ideas worth building on.

Build connections that go beyond the event

Meet fellow developers, founders, students, technology professionals, and community builders. Find collaborators, exchange ideas, and discover opportunities to take your projects further.

Celebrate the builder community

DevFest is also a celebration of the people who make our community what it is - the builders who experiment, the mentors who guide, the volunteers who make things happen, and everyone who helps others grow.

Calling All Builders

Have you built an AI application, a prototype, an open-source tool, a side project, or an early-stage product?

We want to hear from you.

DevFest Lucknow 2026 will provide a platform for selected builders to showcase their work and connect with a wider developer community. You don't need to be a startup or have a polished commercial product. If you've built something meaningful and want people to experience it, this opportunity is for you.

Keep an eye out for our Call for Spotlight Projects and submit your work for consideration.

Who Should Attend?

  • Developers and software engineers

  • Students and aspiring technologists

  • AI, cloud, and open-source enthusiasts

  • Product builders and independent developers

  • Startup founders and early-stage teams

  • Technology professionals who want to learn, share, and collaborate

  • Whether you're just starting your journey or already building products, there's a place for you here.

Be Part of the Movement!

Sponsorship Opportunities

Showcase your brand to the brightest minds in tech and support a growing community of developers and product builders.

Interested in partnering with us? Email lucknow.devs@gmail.com to learn more about sponsorship opportunities.

Stay Connected

Follow GDG Lucknow for announcements, speaker reveals, builder stories, and event updates.

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/google-developer-groups-lucknow/

WhatsApp Community: https://chat.whatsapp.com/L5VMIIEiUz90gh5gcOC054
WhatsApp Channel: https://chat.whatsapp.com/L5VMIIEiUz90gh5gcOC054

Join the conversation and stay connected with the community as we build towards DevFest.

The Bigger Idea

We believe communities become stronger when people move from consuming knowledge to creating something with it.

DevFest Lucknow 2026 is our opportunity to celebrate that shift - from attending to learning, from learning to building, and from building individually to growing together.

Come to learn. Stay to discover. Leave ready to build.
